bvp-boom-supersonic:rippling:7ac1fe8e-01.description: Boom is building Superpower — a next-generation natural gas turbine being developed at a pace and cost point the industry says isn't possible. You say something when a part doesn't look right, stock is running low, or a machine sounds different than it did yesterday. You're genuinely interested in CNC, CMM, or machining — not just willing to learn them if asked, but actually curious about how they work. You've worked somewhere that didn't give you room to grow and you're done with it. Boom is building something that hasn't been built before. The people on the shop floor are part of that.
